description.en-US: OpenBiliClaw is a local-first, open-source AI content discovery companion. Its Firefox sidebar connects to the OpenBiliClaw backend you run and turns supported signals into cross-source recommendations and an inspectable private profile. Sources include Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, YouTube, X, Zhihu, Reddit, Linux.do, Bangumi, V2EX, Weibo, and experimental opt-in Instagram. Instagram uses isolated read-only task tabs for bounded public topic/creator discovery and explicit-init liked/saved/following imports. Only boolean session readiness, current-account identity, and normalized fields leave the tab; cookie values, raw responses, search-history writes, and site mutations never do. The extension does not send data to servers operated by the OpenBiliClaw developers.
description.zh-CN: OpenBiliClaw 是本地优先、开源的 AI 内容发现伙伴。Firefox 侧边栏连接由你自行运行的 OpenBiliClaw 后端，将受支持信号转成跨来源推荐与可查看的私有画像。来源包括 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube、X、知乎、Reddit、Linux.do、Bangumi、V2EX、微博，以及实验性、默认关闭的 Instagram。Instagram 只在隔离只读任务页执行有界 topic/creator 发现和显式 init 的点赞/收藏/关注导入；离开任务页的只有布尔会话 readiness、current-account 身份和规范化字段，不上传 Cookie value 或原始响应，不写搜索历史，也不执行站内写操作。插件不会把数据发送到 OpenBiliClaw 开发者运营的服务器。

version.approval_notes: OpenBiliClaw is local-first and requires a user-run backend. It does not load remote code or send telemetry to servers operated by the project. The optional all-sites host permission is requested only when a user explicitly configures a non-local backend; public hosts require HTTPS and device authentication. Linux.do (`https://linux.do/*`), V2EX (`https://*.v2ex.com/*`), Weibo (`*://*.weibo.com/*`, `*://*.weibo.cn/*`), and the default-disabled Instagram permission (`https://*.instagram.com/*`) are read-only. Linux.do, V2EX, and Weibo retain their documented same-origin bounded task flows. Instagram task tabs perform bounded public topic/creator reads or, after a same-origin current-account response confirms identity, liked/saved/following reads. Only normalized fields and a boolean sessionid heartbeat leave the Instagram tab; cookie values, Authorization/CSRF, raw JSON/HTML, challenge pages, browser history, and search-history writes are never uploaded. The extension performs no V2EX write actions, no Weibo write actions, no Linux.do write actions, and no Instagram like/save/follow/comment/message action; it does not automate login, 2FA, or challenges. Data is sent only to the backend configured by the user. A reproducible source archive is attached; from its root run `cd extension`, `npm ci`, then `npm run build:firefox` using Node.js 22. The output submitted for review is `extension/dist-firefox`. See docs/firefox-amo-source-build.md and docs/privacy.md.

release_notes.en-US: Adds experimental opt-in Instagram topic/creator discovery and init-only liked/saved/following imports through isolated, read-only browser tasks. Cookie values and raw responses stay in the browser, partial results are retained, and no Instagram write action is added.
release_notes.zh-CN: 新增实验性、默认关闭的 Instagram topic/creator 发现与 init-only 点赞/收藏/关注导入，全部通过隔离只读浏览器任务完成；Cookie value 与原始响应留在浏览器，部分结果可保留，不增加任何 Instagram 站内写操作。
